unlisted_post_rule: No record-specific field change; global policies still apply.

rules: Any visual containing factual labels, real mechanisms, values, dimensions or measurements must be exact.
Freeform image generation is permitted only for visuals that remain valid if shapes and composition vary and that contain no factual text, numbers or scale relationships.

tool-ui-capture-v1: Capture actual tool output and record settings.
Do not simulate states or manually alter the result.
same-source-output-v1: Use the same source asset, crop and dimensions for every variant.
reproducible-benchmark-v1: Record encoder or library name, version and settings.
Label results as this example, not a universal guarantee.
authoritative-current-spec-v1: Record an authoritative source for each value.
Distinguish recommended, minimum and accepted values.
source-backed-mechanism-v1: Verify labels and relationships against a primary specification or authoritative technical source.

rules: Exact diagrams whose labels or values are essential require adjacent-text-summary or html-table.
Alt text describes the visual; it must not hide a full data table.
An empty heading must receive introductory prose plus the accessible equivalent; a chart must not be the section's only explanation.
Use separate-light-dark for real Orisod interface screenshots when theme-matched screenshots are desired.
Use shared for before-after composites, output crops and raster illustrations; give them a neutral or transparent treatment that works in both themes.
Use shared for SVG and site color variables where appropriate.
Do not build secondary visuals in the first pilot.
Before later construction, replace description-only objects with the full primary_visual schema plus accessible_equivalent.

set.primary_visual.alt.es: Gráfico de barras que compara el tamaño de AVIF, WebP y JPG en este ejemplo con una calidad visual equivalente; AVIF es el archivo más pequeño.

add_verification_requirements: Verify current AVIF, WebP and JPG support claims separately and date the sources.
Measure all three formats with the same source and documented encoders rather than relying only on percentages quoted in the article.

set.primary_visual.alt.es: Curva que muestra cómo el tamaño baja con rapidez entre 100 % y 80 % de calidad y luego se estabiliza; por debajo de 40 % aparecen artefactos visibles.

add_verification_requirements: If the curve is illustrative, label it as such and plot only measured points as exact values.

blocker: Article copy predates Quick clean and Strong compression. Update and re-review the article before specifying or capturing the visual.
notes: Do not use the invented 35 MB example or promise perfect legibility unless reproduced and measured.

set.educational_goal: Readers should understand that extraction works when a PDF contains a text layer; image-only scans require OCR, while some scanned PDFs already include OCR text.
set.primary_visual.alt.en: Side-by-side comparison of a PDF with a selectable text layer, an image-only scan, and a scanned PDF with an OCR text layer.
set.primary_visual.alt.es: Comparación entre un PDF con capa de texto seleccionable, un escaneo compuesto solo por imágenes y un escaneo con una capa de texto OCR.
set.primary_visual.caption.en: Text can be extracted when a PDF contains a text layer. Image-only scans need OCR first.
set.primary_visual.caption.es: El texto puede extraerse cuando el PDF contiene una capa de texto. Los escaneos compuestos solo por imágenes necesitan OCR.

add_verification_requirements: Represent three states: native/selectable text, image-only scan, and scan with OCR text layer.

set.primary_visual.caption.es: Haz clic en un píxel y obtén su código exacto, sin abrir un programa de diseño.

set.primary_visual.caption.en: A complete favicon package commonly includes several files for different browsers and devices.
set.primary_visual.caption.es: Un paquete de favicon completo suele incluir varios archivos para distintos navegadores y dispositivos.

add_verification_requirements: Cross-check every file against the package currently generated by Orisod.
Do not describe all six files as universally required by every site.

set.primary_visual.caption.en: A static QR stores its destination directly. A dynamic QR depends on a redirect service.
set.primary_visual.caption.es: Un QR estático almacena el destino directamente. Un QR dinámico depende de un servicio de redirección.

add_verification_requirements: Avoid the absolute claim that a static QR never expires; the encoded destination or content can still become unavailable.

set.primary_visual.caption.en: In this example, WebP uses 25–35% less data at comparable visual quality.
set.primary_visual.caption.es: En este ejemplo, WebP usa entre un 25 % y un 35 % menos de datos con una calidad visual comparable.

set.primary_visual.caption.en: In this example, lossless WebP preserves every pixel; lossy WebP reduces the file much further.
set.primary_visual.caption.es: En este ejemplo, WebP sin pérdida conserva cada píxel; WebP con pérdida reduce mucho más el archivo.

add_verification_requirements: Record the PNG and JPG encoders, JPG quality and crop magnification.

set.primary_visual.caption.en: In this example, BMP stores the pixels without image compression while JPG reduces the file to a fraction of the size.
set.primary_visual.caption.es: En este ejemplo, BMP almacena los píxeles sin compresión de imagen, mientras que JPG reduce el archivo a una fracción del tamaño.

add_verification_requirements: Benchmark PNG too because it appears in the alt and proposed chart; otherwise remove PNG from both.

set.primary_visual.caption.en: Current recommended sizes for common social media formats.
set.primary_visual.caption.es: Tamaños recomendados actuales para los formatos más habituales en redes sociales.

add_verification_requirements: Store a source and verification date for every platform and placement.
Review quarterly and always before changing the year in the title.
Translate placement labels in the Spanish version.
Publish the exact values as a semantic HTML table; use the SVG only as a complementary visual.

set.primary_visual.caption.en: In this example, WebP is smaller at comparable visual quality; compatibility should also be checked in the apps used by the audience.
set.primary_visual.caption.es: En este ejemplo, WebP es más pequeño con una calidad visual comparable; también conviene comprobar la compatibilidad con las aplicaciones que usa el público.

add_verification_requirements: Verify browser and non-browser software support from current authoritative sources and record the date.

set.primary_visual.alt.en: Illustration of a photo carrying hidden location, time, and camera information.
set.primary_visual.alt.es: Ilustración de una foto que lleva información oculta de ubicación, hora y cámara.
set.primary_visual.caption.en: When present, details such as location, time, and device information can travel with the file.
set.primary_visual.caption.es: Cuando están presentes, datos como la ubicación, la hora y el dispositivo pueden viajar con el archivo.

replace_verification_requirements: Generate a text-free symbolic illustration with no coordinates, timestamps, device model or factual field labels embedded in the image.
notes: If factual labels are retained, reject this redesign and instead keep SVG/hybrid while changing precision to exact.

set.primary_visual.caption.en: Choose the position and starting number before applying the numbering.
set.primary_visual.caption.es: Elige la posición y el número inicial antes de aplicar la numeración.
Un borde fino produce un efecto clásico; uno más grueso resulta más llamativo.
Base64 aumenta el tamaño a cambio de poder incrustar los datos como texto.

replace_verification_requirements: Use the exact encoded-length formula 4 × ceil(n / 3), plus any data-URL prefix shown. Describe roughly 33% as an asymptotic overhead, not an exact value for every small file.

add_verification_requirements: Inspect the actual tool algorithm before claiming that it preserves luminance differently from reducing saturation.

notes: Keep the existing synthetic, licensed-stock or model-released subject requirement.

set.primary_visual.caption.en: Reorder the photos before combining them; the final list order becomes the PDF page order.
set.primary_visual.caption.es: Reordena las fotos antes de combinarlas; el orden final de la lista será el orden de las páginas del PDF.

notes: Approved as a genuinely illustrative imagegen use case.

set.primary_visual.caption.es: Algunas aplicaciones leen la etiqueta de orientación; otras muestran los píxeles tal como están almacenados.

add_verification_requirements: Verify the chosen EXIF Orientation value and its rendered transformation.
Do not freehand-generate the orientation tag, value or 90° relationship.

set.primary_visual.caption.en: Convert HEIC to JPG without installing software.
set.primary_visual.caption.es: Convierte HEIC a JPG sin instalar programas.

set.primary_visual.caption.en: The photo is placed into a standard PDF file in one step.
set.primary_visual.caption.es: La foto se incorpora a un archivo PDF estándar en un solo paso.

add_verification_requirements: Inspect whether the implementation embeds the JPG bytes or decodes and recompresses them before making any pixel-preservation claim.

set.primary_visual.caption.en: Reorder the files, then merge them without rasterizing the pages.
set.primary_visual.caption.es: Reordena los archivos y únelos sin rasterizar las páginas.

add_verification_requirements: Verify what page content and document features the merge library preserves; avoid absolute intact or exactly-the-same claims.

set.educational_goal: Readers should understand that a PDF page may combine text, vector graphics and embedded raster images, and rasterization renders the complete page into a fixed pixel grid.
set.primary_visual.alt.en: Diagram showing a PDF page with text, vector graphics, and embedded images rendered into a fixed pixel grid.
set.primary_visual.alt.es: Diagrama que muestra una página PDF con texto, gráficos vectoriales e imágenes incrustadas renderizada en una cuadrícula fija de píxeles.
set.primary_visual.caption.en: Rasterization renders the complete PDF page into a fixed grid of pixels.
set.primary_visual.caption.es: La rasterización convierte la página PDF completa en una cuadrícula fija de píxeles.

add_verification_requirements: Confirm the checkerboard represents actual alpha transparency in the output, not a background baked into the image.
Use a synthetic signature visibly marked SAMPLE; never use a real signature or personal document.

set.primary_visual.caption.en: Extract one page range as a PDF, or split every page into separate files.
set.primary_visual.caption.es: Extrae un rango de páginas como PDF o separa cada página en un archivo individual.

set.primary_visual.caption.en: The page content stays the same; only the visible page boundary changes.
set.primary_visual.caption.es: El contenido de la página no cambia; solo cambia el límite visible de la página.
Una marca diagonal con opacidad moderada sigue siendo visible sin ocultar el contenido.

add_verification_requirements: Use a synthetic document with no real names, addresses or confidential content.

set.primary_visual.caption.en: EXIF, IPTC, and XMP overlap, but each emphasizes different kinds of metadata.
set.primary_visual.caption.es: EXIF, IPTC y XMP se superponen, pero cada uno da prioridad a distintos tipos de metadatos.

replace_verification_requirements: Verify the table against CIPA/EXIF, IPTC and Adobe/XMP documentation. Explain overlap and namespaces; do not present the standards as mutually exclusive buckets.

set.primary_visual.caption.en: Convert WebP to PNG for broader compatibility with apps that do not support WebP.
set.primary_visual.caption.es: Convierte WebP a PNG para usarlo en más aplicaciones que no admiten WebP.

optional_sixth.reason: Add only if the code-svg ownership label must be tested separately from the technically equivalent hybrid SVG pipeline.

remove_from_current_pilot.reason: Replace with the higher-priority EXIF conceptual pilot after the text-free redesign.
Duplicates the precise-comparison path and adds secondary-visual complexity too early.
